our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes the approximately 75% ARC-AGI-1 result the relevant December demonstration.
The claim covers o3-named models and their publicly available reasoning settings as of the post, including o3-mini.

For this ongoing observation, the target is the April release-period state before publication.

criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one o3-named model released by the post reliably achieves approximately 75% or better under comparable evaluation conditions.
